correctness.rationale: Complete explicit 3-world frame and valuation. The diamond operator maps every upset into {empty,{b},W}. The box-only Heyting subalgebra {empty,{b,c},W} is closed under its modal action. Mixed formula box(p implies diamond p) is true exactly at {a,c}, not an upset because a<b. A two-world-case proof covers all preorders, relations and any persistent atomic vocabulary. Depth-one impossibility follows by induction. verify.py recomputes finite truth algebras and exhaustive 1-2-world tests; enumerations corroborate but are not used for unrestricted claims.

value.rationale: Direct negative resolution of Sato 2026 Problem 3.10, an explicit recently posed logical compositionality question. Sharp three-world and depth-two thresholds establish that the distinction is substantive even in the smallest nontrivial models. The finding is not a special case of universal frame-level confluence and suggests that fixed-valuation fragment invariance does not compose.
